name: Outbound data guard
summary: Block explicit local-file uploads and dynamic payloads sent by common network commands.
description: A framework-agnostic deterministic policy core with a Claude Code PreToolUse adapter. It applies bounded shell parsing to high-confidence upload flags, local-to-remote transfers, piped network streams, and uninspectable dynamic payloads without logging their values.
refuses: It does not inspect, print, upload, redact, or retain the contents of any local file or payload.
It does not claim to prevent every network path, covert channel, child process, or application protocol.
It does not accept project-controlled configuration or provide a hidden bypass for blocked transfers.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate shell transfer intent and block explicit outbound local-data boundaries before execution.
